name: Silanth
bio: Silanth always did what she wanted. And when the rebel Princess heard of a vampire lord that could hold the secret to halting the curse burning in her veins, she headed straight over. She got him to give her exactly what she wanted – all the power of the Roseblood Curse, none of the downsides.
